subject: Field seat sourcing — approval request and comp band guidance
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Field seat sourcing — approval request and comp band guidance

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Following our Q2 coverage planning, hiring ops and I recommend opening 3 field-facing seats this quarter to support the BrightWave (mid-market) expansion:

- AE (Mid-Market) — replacement for AE#42 (vacated), suggested comp band: Base $95k–$115k, OTE $180k–$220k.
- CSM (Enterprise) — net-new seat to own onboarding/expansion, suggested comp band: Base $120k–$140k, OTE $160k–$200k.
- SE (Solutions Engineer) — convert contractor to FTE (urgent for onboarding new integration), suggested comp band: Base $140k–$165k, total comp target $170k–$200k.

Rationale: BrightWave is closing a pilot with two product teams; we expect $2.1M ARR in 12 months if we staff CSM + SE to support ramp. The AE seat is priority for coverage — candidate inbound (J. Sanchez) is currently in market and requires quick offer.

Attachments: headcount_request_q3.xlsx (budget & ramp), comp_band_proposal_redwood_gomarket.pdf.

Ask: Can I get authorization to post the CSM and AE as of next Monday and permission to extend an exception offer to J. Sanchez at the top of the AE band if needed? If approved, I will raise the Workday req and push offers via DocuSign.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Talent Partner, Go-to-Market
Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0128

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field seat sourcing — approval request and comp band guidance

Thanks Priya — question on a couple items before I sign off:

1) AE band: where does this sit vs our regional AE bands? The base range looks fine but I want to understand OTE cadence and quota alignment (Q1 ramp vs Q3 fully productive).
2) CSM: is this a new headcount or a reallocation from existing CS bench? Need forecasted retention impact.
3) SE conversion: we generally prefer to convert at the mid-band to reduce comp churn; any candidate-specific asks?

I support moving quickly if we can: please add expected first day / ramp timeline to the spreadsheet and add the candidate comp asks to the offer drafts. If it's urgent for the AE candidate, provide a one-paragraph justification for exception approval and I'll loop Aditya for final sign-off.

-Marissa
VP, Go-to-Market Operations

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, J. Sanchez <jsanchez@talentpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field seat sourcing — approval request and comp band guidance

Marissa — quick answers inline and added two offer drafts to attachments: offer_J_Sanchez_draft.pdf and offer_L_Nguyen_draft.pdf.

1) AE band: This maps to SF region AE-Mid band (see comp_band_proposal_redwood_gomarket.pdf). Quota for this role would be $950k ARR first 12 months; 50% attainment expected by month 6.
2) CSM: Net-new headcount; we reallocated a portion of Q3 professional services budget to cover year 1 onboarding (sheet tab "Funding Realloc").
3) SE conversion: Candidate (L. Nguyen) is the contractor we've had for 7 months; they are fully embedded — recommended at 60th percentile of SE band to secure retention.

Exception request for J. Sanchez (AE candidate): background: current comp is $125k base + $120k commission; candidate will lose a sign-on from current employer if we delay. Ask: permission to offer AE at $115k base + $20k sign-on + OTE $225k (slightly above band in total OTE via sign-on). Justification: immediate ramp potential (already has pipeline from pilot), hiring risk if we wait.

If you approve the exception, I'll draft the DocuSign and call Aditya for the final go/no-go.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field seat sourcing — approval request and comp band guidance

Thanks for the detail. I approve the three seats to be posted and the SE conversion. Conditions:

- AE exception: I will approve a single AE exception at the top of the band with a one-time sign-on if the candidate demonstrates pipeline that converts to closed-won within 90 days (we need a 90-day performance contingency clause in the offer).
- Keep base compensation within the band; push variable into first-year commission / sign-on.
- Please cap sign-on to $20k for AE, and ensure budget offset shows in the headcount sheet.

Priya — proceed to generate Workday req and the DocuSign offer. Vivek, please flag any budget concerns.

-Aditya
VP Sales, North America

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field seat sourcing — approval request and comp band guidance

Reviewed. Conditional approval from Finance: we can support the AE sign-on ($20k) and SE conversion at 60th percentile provided hiring ops posts the budget reallocation ticket and the hiring manager accepts a 6-month check-in (headcount cost review). Please do the following before offers go live:

- Create a Jira HRREQ ticket with approved offsets and approvals (HRREQ-4021 is open; attach final spreadsheet).
- Add a clause in DocuSign: 90-day performance contingency for sign-on forgiveness if performance milestones not met.
- Confirm total FY27 headcount run-rate change in the workday req link.

Once those are in place I will mark budget as committed.

-Vivek
Dir, Finance (GTM)
